faqCatalog.question: What is the shelf compliance Golden Zone rule?
faqCatalog.answer: Primary products (like Dove and Lux beauty bars) must reside in the Golden Zone (shoulder-to-waist shelf range, ideally 1.2M to 1.6M above floor level). They are required to hold at least 45% category shelf space width.

faqCatalog.question: How should critical Out-Of-Stock (OOS) levels be resolved?
faqCatalog.answer: When stock drops to Critical OOS (e.g. Dove Cream Bar zero count), immediately place a replenishment draft. If the quantity is above 25 units, auto-apply Scheme A (15% Case Discount) with the South Distributor PRIORITY delivery.

faqCatalog.question: What is the camera signage SIFT verification threshold?
faqCatalog.answer: The storefront board registration uses SIFT keypoint descriptor matching. A valid store check-in requires a SIFT score >= 80% with green GPS validation. This authenticates the physical presence of the field agent.
